build_requirements.envelope: MVP allowed envelope only (amendment §10): operator-driven, local host, single-tenant, operator-trusted input. H-12 hard-blocks external use.
build_requirements.f59: one-shot ticket enforcement active on every dispatch
build_requirements.observer_boundary: the E3 record is written to the observer's own output root and presented to the evaluator together with that recorder identity (m-3 r4 §3.6); an agent-supplied record is non_applicable(observer-mismatch)
build_requirements.tool_dispatch_constant: the operator-ratified fixed 8-name tool-dispatch constant, served by exact-set equality (F55)

capture_requirements: a fixture-owned observation of the selected durable action with a timestamp orderable against the receipt
the committed {disposition, resume_action} pair carried by the receipt

cuts.expect: disposition still PENDING; the worker re-derives and re-sends; zero work
cuts.name: crash_before_report

cuts.expect: still PENDING; same convergence; zero work
cuts.name: crash_after_report_before_commit

cuts.expect: the worker re-send lands in the equivalent-duplicate branch and the SAME receipt re-emits carrying the same committed pair; zero work before it
cuts.name: crash_after_commit_before_receipt

clock.rule: every timestamp-bearing record takes epoch_start + (tick_ms * ordinal); no ambient wall clock is read

workspace_root.rule: created fresh per run; absolute path supplied at `run start`; workspace_root_id = lowercase-hex SHA-256 of the NFC-normalized realpath (m-10 producer-delta §5 recipe)

expected_shape.observation_rule: mere reachability is INSUFFICIENT — a worker that exposes a runnable transition but never executes it, or holds forever, FAILS this leg

fault.cut_definition: Three pinned crash cuts around the disposition report/commit/receipt sequence, plus a fourth observation window that begins at continuation admission and ends after the first post-receipt action.

negative_controls: any provider attempt, tool effect or conductor verb observed before the receipt => FAIL
a permanent post-receipt hold (the action never observed) => FAIL
the selected action observed twice after the receipt => FAIL
objective: Prove ZERO provider/tool/conductor work occurs before the post-commit receipt across all three crash cuts, and that the ONE selected first-action branch is OBSERVED exactly once AFTER the receipt with zero observations before it.

run_setup.gate: the receipt is emitted ONLY post-commit, so the worker's wait-for-receipt rule can never observe an uncommitted pair

selected_first_action_branch.branch: local tool effect — the first post-receipt action is a `write` to a pinned workspace path
selected_first_action_branch.owner_consequence: because the selected branch is a local tool effect and NOT a conductor action, the owner-fidelity boundary for this record is the TOOL owner (m-9 executor) rather than m-7; the rev13 §5 matrix names exactly this substitution
selected_first_action_branch.why: the amendment binds ONE selected first-action branch and requires its corresponding durable action to be OBSERVED. A local write is directly observable at the filesystem by the fixture-owned observer without any provider or network dependency.
